gbm_population_evidence.quote: MR-guided LITT Therapy in Patients With Primary Irresectable Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: The Visualase Thermal Therapy System is used to necrotize or coagulate soft tissue through interstitial irradiation under MRI guidance

coder_notes: Device/procedure-only trial (laser interstitial thermal therapy). Only one arm is registered; the summary describes randomisation to biopsy and LITT vs biopsy alone (randomisation stopped by amendment), but no control arm is registered, so control_arm_from_other_arms is not_applicable. Registered phase is NA.
